summary: Again lands a bent hand onto the palm of the other hand, like something coming around one more time. It's also how you say 'repeat' and 'one more time.'
handshape: Bent B hand onto a flat palm
movement: Dominant hand arcs over and lands fingertips-first on the other palm
steps: Hold your non-dominant hand flat, palm up.
Bend your dominant hand at the knuckles and arc it over to land the fingertips in the other palm.
Repeat the landing to mean 'again and again.'
note: AGAIN is one of the most useful signs for a learner. SIGN AGAIN, with a friendly face, is how you ask for a repeat without apologizing.
mistakes: Slapping the palm with a flat hand. The fingertips of a bent hand land, not the whole hand.
